message.content:
The episode where Del Boy falls through the bar is **"Yuppy Love"**, the first episode of Series 6 of *Only Fools and Horses*. It originally aired on **8th January 1989** on BBC1.

In this iconic scene, Del is at a wine bar with Trigger, trying to impress two women who smile at them. Unaware that the barman has lifted up the bar flap, Del tells Trigger to "play it nice and cool" as he goes to lean on the bar, only to fall straight through it. Trigger then looks around wondering where Del has gone.

The scene was reportedly based on a real-life incident where writer John Sullivan saw a man in a pub lean on a bar with the flap open. While the real man managed to catch himself, David Jason suggested that Del should go all the way over for maximum comedic effect. It has since been voted the greatest *Only Fools and Horses* moment of all time in multiple polls.
